scenario.name: r-cd-3-post-compaction
scenario.description: Fill a disposable session with real prior turns until its measured usage passes the request_compaction threshold, stage continue_delegate(mode=post-compaction), then call request_compaction. PASS requires the bound accepted request_compaction toolResult, the released lifeboat child, the lifeboat's own minted token and the requester reproducing it outside the proof and fill runs. An unknown or unmeasured rejection is PARTIAL, never PASS; a measured below-threshold rejection is a separate PARTIAL reason.
scenario.notes: Does not lower thresholds or mutate config: the fill sends inert filler turns and reads fresh totalTokens/contextTokens from sessions.describe, the inputs request_compaction measures. The fill runs only in a disposable session and stops, with the reason named, when the measured gap cannot be closed within OPENCLAW_RCD3_FILL_MAX_TURNS (default 6) or OPENCLAW_RCD3_FILL_BUDGET_TOKENS (default 300000). No sentinel is read from the requester's event stream (openclaw-bootstrap#1727).

invocation.promptTemplate: RCD3:{{nonceSuffix16}} R-CD-3 post-compaction lifeboat nonce {{nonce}}: when you run, invent a fresh random token of exactly 12 lowercase letters and digits (make it up now; do not copy it from anywhere) and reply exactly RCD3-LIFEBOAT {{nonce}} TOKEN <your token>. Requester: when this lifeboat result reaches you, reply exactly RCD3-PARENT-RETURN {{nonce}} TOKEN <the TOKEN value from this result>. Do not mutate files.

prerequisites.contextUsage: Established by the scenario: inert filler turns until fresh totalTokens/contextTokens reaches the fill target (default 75%, above the fixed 70% threshold, below the automatic-compaction line near window minus reserve). A 200k window needs about 150k filler tokens; a window too large for the fill budget stops the fill and the row is PARTIAL.
prerequisites.notes: The accepted path compacts the disposable proof session only. Cost scales with the context window: each fill turn re-sends the growing context.

expectedReceipts.name: dispatch-accepted
expectedReceipts.description: Gateway accepted the sessions.send proof turn after the measured fill reached its target

expectedReceipts.name: measured-context-fill
expectedReceipts.description: sessions.describe reported fresh totalTokens/contextTokens at or above the fill target before the proof turn

expectedReceipts.name: delegate-staging-receipt
expectedReceipts.description: The continue_delegate toolResult bound by toolCallId to the call whose task carries the row token answered queued-for-compaction in post-compaction mode

expectedReceipts.name: request-compaction-receipt
expectedReceipts.description: The request_compaction toolResult bound by toolCallId to the call whose reason carries the row nonce; accepted (compaction_requested) for PASS. Unknown usage and measured below-threshold rejections are distinct PARTIAL reasons

expectedReceipts.name: released-lifeboat-child
expectedReceipts.description: A child whose own row names the proof session in spawnedBy and whose own spawn task carries the product [continuation:post-compaction] prefix and the row token

expectedReceipts.name: lifeboat-minted-token
expectedReceipts.description: The lifeboat's own assistant text carries RCD3-LIFEBOAT <nonce> TOKEN <12 chars>, a token absent from every harness-sent text

expectedReceipts.name: lifeboat-return-bound
expectedReceipts.description: The proof session reproduces RCD3-PARENT-RETURN <nonce> TOKEN <token> in a run other than the proof and fill runs, not earlier than the token

expectedReceipts.name: trace-id
expectedReceipts.description: Trace ID for gateway/session dispatch correlation when available

expectedReceipts.name: tempo-trace-json
expectedReceipts.description: Public-safe Tempo trace JSON (tempo-trace-<id>.json) for the continue_delegate tool → continuation.delegate.dispatch → continuation.delegate.fire topology, collected by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. Required for every continuation row (#600).

expectedReceipts.name: continuation-trace-correlation
expectedReceipts.description: continuation-trace-correlation.json: exactly one Tempo trace matched by the row’s reason hash, length, and delegate mode, holding one continuation.delegate.dispatch span, one continuation.delegate.fire span, and the originating continue_delegate tool span on one trace and chain.

review.notes: R-CD-3 is PASS-candidate only on the bound chain: accepted request_compaction, released lifeboat child, its minted token, and the requester reproducing it. An unknown or unmeasured request_compaction rejection is PARTIAL with its own reason, distinct from R-RC-2's measured threshold rejection; never overclaim compaction firing.

census.limits: The census found accepted continuation entry spans carry no origin, session, turn, or run identity and that proof traffic carries no marker, so this row’s trace receipt joins the continue_delegate tool span to continuation.delegate.dispatch and continuation.delegate.fire only by shared trace, causal timing, and the reason fingerprint and mode. The scenario records the fingerprint of the staged lifeboat task, which the manifest template reproduces from the nonce. At karmaterminal/openclaw 293c977f62 the product releases a post-compaction lifeboat from post-compaction-delegate-delivery.ts without a continuation.delegate.dispatch or .fire span (only continuation.compaction.released, which carries no reason), so no trace carries that fingerprint: the collector stays fail-closed and the trace receipts stay pending until the product emits the delegate spans on that path.

spans.name: continuation.delegate.dispatch
spans.notes: Accepted entry span. Carries no origin/session/turn/run identity.

spans.name: openclaw.tool.execution
spans.notes: Typed continue_delegate evidence. Joined to the dispatch span only by shared trace and causal timing.

spans.name: continuation.compaction.released
spans.notes: Emitted only on an accepted compaction, so its absence cannot distinguish a refusal from a missing trace.

attributes.notes: Emitted today and asserted by collect-continuation-trace.mjs. It is the strongest join currently available and it is not an identity.
Accepted entry spans carry no signal.kind on the census product basis; origin is contracted by R-OBS-CONT-PROVENANCE.
No k6/Project-81 resource or trace marker exists, so this row’s traffic cannot be separated from organic fleet traffic in a later census.

redaction.rule: Delegate task material is published only as a digest, a length and the delegate mode, inside a public-safe Tempo projection. Task text, prompt bodies, raw nonces, raw session keys, and gateway tokens never enter the artifact.

controls.positive: After a measured fill, continue_delegate(mode=post-compaction) is staged (bound toolResult), request_compaction is accepted (bound toolResult), the released lifeboat child mints a token in its own transcript, and the requester reproduces it in a later run.
controls.negative: A sentinel in the requester's own tool call or event stream never counts. An unknown or unmeasured rejection is PARTIAL, never PASS; a measured below-threshold rejection is PARTIAL; a prose-only report of compaction does not satisfy the row.

backendUnavailable.notes: A degraded or empty Tempo answer leaves tempo-trace-json and its correlation receipt pending. That is review debt, not evidence that the continuation did not happen, and it never changes the VU verdict.

verdictAuthority.pass: The bound chain: accepted request_compaction toolResult, queued-for-compaction staging toolResult, released lifeboat child (own spawnedBy + own post-compaction spawn task), its minted token, and the requester reproducing that token outside the proof and fill runs. Behavioral only; the trace receipts decide review completeness, not the verdict.
verdictAuthority.partial: A fill that cannot reach the measured target; an unknown or unmeasured rejection (never PASS); a measured below-threshold rejection; any other request_compaction answer; or an accepted compaction whose lifeboat, report or return is not bound. A missing or degraded trace keeps the row review-pending without changing its class.
verdictAuthority.fail: The proof turn was rejected, or neither a staging receipt nor a request_compaction result is bound to it.

execution.deterministicK6: r-cd-3-post-compaction.js fills a disposable session with measured prior turns, stages the delegate and calls request_compaction, then binds the lifeboat and its return from product records.
execution.manual: Manual Tempo review confirms the dispatch/fire topology; it cannot supply the missing identity attributes.
execution.relationship: The deterministic row owns the verdict. The Tempo trace receipts decide only whether review is complete; manual review corroborates topology and never upgrades a missing receipt.

liveRunSafety.notes: Runs only in a disposable session: the fill refuses OPENCLAW_CREATE_DISPOSABLE_SESSION=false. Does not mutate config or thresholds; an accepted compaction compacts that proof session only. The fill sends real model turns sized to the measured context window, so cost grows with the window; the token and turn budgets bound it.
